name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task reads 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.' The 'Then' at the start of the second sentence links it to the preceding conditional. Per the rule for a command opening with an order word after an 'if x, (also) y' sentence, the step z (target_picked_up) is required after y (has_door_key) and after x when x happens (blocker_moved). Two clauses are missing: (1) a hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) — the box pickup must not occur before the key has been acquired; and (2) a hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) — if the ball is moved, the box pickup must come at or after that step. Add both; keep the existing RespondedExistence and Existence(target_picked_up).

texts: If the blocking ball is moved away from the door, the agent must also acquire the matching key at some point.
Pick up the mission's designated box.
The box pickup must not occur before the matching key has been acquired.
If the blocking ball is moved, the box pickup must come at or after that step.
